items.title: Rare Hilma af Klint Masterpiece Commands a Record-Breaking $12.7 Million USD at Auction
items.summary:
Summary 

A 1920 abstract painting by pioneering artist Hilma af Klint recently sold for a record-breaking $12.7 million USD at a Swedish auction houseThe rare offering of 'Ser III No. 5' marks a historic moment for the artist whose foundation typically keeps her work strictly off the marketThe unprecedented sale sparked controversy among art historians who argue the esoteric work was never intended for commercial consumption

Pioneering artist Hilma af Klint has set a new posthumous record following the landmark sale of her 1920 abstraction, Ser III No. 5 . Hosted by the Bukowskis auction house in Stockholm, the extremely rare market appearance resulted in a staggering $12.7 million USD final price, a sum roughly 15 times its initial high estimate of $800,000 USD.

Held closely by a single unnamed family since 1995, the painting was originally acquired after the artist's foundation deaccessioned a small number of works. The sale adds a lucrative new chapter to af Klint's posthumous ascent. While the artist remained relatively obscure following her death in 1944, a series of blockbuster museum exhibitions in the 2010s—including a record-shattering 2018 showcase at the New York Guggenheim Museum—firmly repositioned her as a foundational inventor of European abstraction. Her enigmatic canvases, featuring dazzling arrays of curlicuing lines and inscrutable symbols, were famously created in response to spirits she contacted.

Because the foundation generally restricts her artwork from entering the commercial market, the recent Bukowskis auction sparked debate among art…
items.t: Rare Hilma af Klint Masterpiece Commands a Record-Breaking $12.7 Million USD at Auction

The official trailer for the highly anticipated period biopic, Maserati: The Brothers . Scheduled to hit the big screen early next year, the film chronicles the real-life story of how the titular family defied the odds to launch one of the most iconic luxury car manufacturers in Italian history.

The star-studded project features an acclaimed ensemble cast, including Al Pacino , Anthony Hopkins , Jessica Alba , and Andy Garcia . Taking on the pivotal roles of the visionary siblings, the movie stars Michele Morrone, Salvatore Esposito, and Lorenzo De Moor as the real-life Alfieri, Bindo, and Carlo Maserati, respectively.

According to the film's official synopsis, the movie carefully follows the Maserati family's journey starting from its initial founding in 1914. From those early days, the cinematic narrative tracks the brand's ambitious goal to revolutionize car racing, ultimately cementing its status as a renowned Italian luxury car manufacturer competing alongside historic rivals like Ferrari and Lamborghini.

Maserati: The Brothers officially releases in theaters on January 29, 2027.

items.title: Cherry Los Angeles' Holiday '26 Collection Is Made for the Long Way Home
items.summary:
Cherry Los Angeles is leaning into rugged Americana for its Holiday '26 collection, a winter range built around the kind of outdoor clothing that used to get handed down rather than replaced. The Los Angeles label focuses on hardwearing materials and careful construction, with pieces designed to look better the longer they're worn.

Outerwear leads the collection, starting with shearling aviators and leather jackets cut from a leather Cherry developed in-house to soften and take on character over time. Stone-washed canvas work jackets offer a lighter option with a broken-in look from day one. Under those heavier pieces, hand-loomed alpaca sweaters and garment-dyed heavyweight hoodies handle the mid-layer.

Thermals do much of the work in the rest of the range. The Best In The West, Ranchwear Boxy and Chevron Henley styles cover everything from western graphics to waffle-knit henleys, while the Frontier Henley Sherpa and Zip Up Sherpa Jacket add pile-lined warmth. Wide Leg Cargo Pants in Woodland Camo, a Plaid Western Shirt and an American Flag Knit Crew push the outdoorsman theme further. The women's lineup includes Knit Rugby shirts in Cabernet Red and Oatmeal, fitted T-shirts and eagle-graphic thermals.

The palette stays grounded in workwear tones such as Vintage Black, Smoke, Faded Navy, Oatmeal and Cabernet Red, with bursts of orange and camo. A full run of 5 Star and American Truckers plus 5- and 6-panel caps finishes off the look.

Cherry Los Angeles' Holiday '26 collection is available online and at Cherry stores.

Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast
items.t: Cherry Los Angeles' Holiday '26 Collection Is Made for the Long Way Home

NBA superstar LeBron James has officially taken legal action against PlayVision Inc. and its AI -powered sports betting research app, "Bron," over the alleged unauthorized use of his name, likeness, and voice. Filed on Tuesday, November 17, the lawsuit claims the California-based company deliberately deployed an artificial intelligence-generated version of the athlete to promote its platform without permission.

The legal dispute centers on a heavily circulated advertisement that accumulated approximately one million views and reposts before being removed. The campaign featured a digitally recreated basketball player wearing a No. 23 jersey and displaying tattoos resembling those of the Philadelphia 76ers forward. The character also utilized a voice explicitly intended to sound like James, shown browsing betting information involving other professional NBA players. James’ attorneys argue the campaign went beyond borrowing his appearance, creating a highly misleading impression that he actively endorsed the platform.

The distinction carries significant weight, as NBA rules strictly prohibit players from betting on league games. Furthermore, James already holds an existing…

Art Basel Hong Kong has revealed the gallery line-up for its 2027 edition, with 232 exhibitors from more than 40 countries and territories heading to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre (HKCEC) in March. Thirty-one of those galleries are first-time participants, from places as far apart as Georgia, Estonia, Thailand and Brazil. The fair is also reworking how visitors move through the building, with a new floor plan that puts its experimental sectors side by side.

The biggest structural change is on Level 3 of the HKCEC, where Discoveries, Echoes, Insights and Zero 10 will now share a single floor. The Asia-Pacific region remains the fair's core, and more than half of all participating galleries run spaces there. Twenty-seven have locations in Hong Kong itself, including Blindspot Gallery, Empty…

items.title: Children of the revolution: how the north of England is defining modern men’s fashion
items.summary:
Once the historic centre of the textile industry, the north is now home to a host of a provenance-driven labels. But is there a specific northern menswear look? And what does it all mean for the mad-fer-it stereotypes?

In 2026, clothing has proved more important to Andy Burnham’s political identity than that of any British prime minister since Margaret Thatcher. He is a loyal Clarks and Adidas wearer, whose Howick worker’s jacket hangs in Manchester’s People’s History Museum. His ousting of Keir Starmer – launched shortly before being photographed jogging in a replica Everton shirt – has been memorialised as the “casual coup”. In one telling, the reason for this is simple: he’s a man from the north.

That Burnham is the first born-and-bred northern male PM since Harold Wilson last swished his Gannex raincoat out of Downing Street goes some way to explaining his higher interest in clothing. It’s not necessarily that all men in the south care less about clothing, or that all men in the north do – but that many men from the north express it in such a distinctive, even unified, way.

Continue reading...
items.t: Children of the revolution: how the north of England is defining modern men’s fashion

The exhibition title, Dépôt, means a storage or workspace. The show reinterprets this concept as a place where art and craftsmanship intersect. In a space reminiscent of a warehouse, visitors will find collaborative artworks by DRAGON76 and COOK, hand-finished edition pieces titled *OBS HELLO MY NAME IS POSTER*, and custom-painted work tools used in actual art production. The exhibition focuses not only on finished pieces but also on the process from creation to product.

The lineup combines the functionality of workwear with artistic expression, offering pieces like formal jackets, utility jackets, and twill pants. These items incorporate the distinct artworks of DRAGON76 and COOK and…

items.title: Snow Peak Introduces Arma Stove, a New Wood-Burning Stove That Lets You Enjoy the Flames from Any Angle
items.summary:
Leading Japanese outdoor brand Snow Peak is releasing a new wood-burning stove, the Arma Stove (ST-210). Featuring heat-resistant glass on all four sides, its design allows you to view the flames from any direction. It is proposed not just as a heating appliance for winter campsites, but as the centerpiece of a living space where family and friends naturally gather.

Unlike standard wood-burning stoves, this item, with heat-resistant glass placed on all four sides, lets you enjoy the flickering flames no matter where you sit. A spark arrestor inside the chimney suppresses the scattering of sparks, considering its impact on tents, tarps, and surrounding gear.

Its setup method is also unique, accommodating integration with the separately sold Arma Stand or Iron Grill Table (IGT) frame. You can choose a setup style that fits your campsite layout and usage scenario. It weighs 19.6kg, including attached parts like the chimney set. Note that it cannot be used directly on the ground by itself and must be combined with the specified products.

It is also intended to be used in combination with the large two-room shelter Land Lock X, which Snow Peak released in June 2026. Currently, it is also approved for use inside the Merak Pro. When using it inside a tent, a fly cover must be used together, and the specified tent body and setup method must be confirmed in advance through official information.

Snow Peak's Arma Stove will be available starting Saturday, November 28th. The price is ¥162,800 (including tax). The separately sold Arma Stand is scheduled for release in 2027.

The X Jersey goes back to 2001, when the original XBOX arrived as a heavy black console with acidic green accents and a raised X across its casing. Dyenamik turns that shape into a tonal X on the front and back of a black body, with darker panels that echo the sculpted ridges of the first console. R&B singer Summer Walker is officially escalating her ongoing legal battle with Interscope Records . According to legal documents and a recent report from Billboard , the artist filed a countersuit on Wednesday, November 18, seeking at least $20 million USD from the label over allegations that it improperly generated revenue from her independently created digital content.

The core of the newly filed dispute revolves around Walker's 2017 contract with Interscope and the label's alleged use of videos and material tied to her personal YouTube channel. Walker argues that while her agreement permitted the company to use her name, image, and likeness for promotional purposes, it did not grant unrestricted ownership or monetization rights over assets she created independently. Her legal team, led by attorney Keith Moten, is seeking at least $20 million USD in damages alongside the recovery of any profits generated through the disputed material.

KFC Spain has officially unveiled "The Replacement Disc," offering fans a unique fried chicken alternative to celebrate the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 . As Rockstar Games transitions away from traditional physical media by including only a digital download code in the game's physical edition, the fast-food chain is stepping in to give gamers a tangible—and edible—addition to their empty cases.

The limited-edition promotion playfully addresses the ongoing shift toward digital distribution while rewarding dedicated fans. KFC has crafted a custom piece of fried chicken designed to substitute the missing physical disc. Adding to the novelty of the gaming crossover, the fast-food giant has also designed exclusive packaging that features Colonel Sanders on the cover, making the meal resemble a traditional video game of its own.

According to KFC Spain, the initiative was created as a direct response to collectors and players debating the future of boxed video games. Rather than offering a standard promotional item, the brand is providing a humorous twist on the modern unboxing experience. items.title: A24's Elizabeth Holmes 'You Can See Everything' Documentary Crosses the $100 Million USD Mark
items.summary:
Summary 

A24's hit documentary 'You Can See Everything' has officially surpassed the $100 million USD mark at the global box officeThe secretly produced Elizabeth Holmes film has generated $93.4 million USD domestically alongside a growing international rolloutThe massive financial milestone cements the nearly three-hour project as one of the highest-grossing theatrical documentaries in history

A24 and its hit documentary You Can See Everything have officially crossed a massive theatrical milestone. Surpassing $100 million USD at the global box office, the zeitgeist-capturing look at Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes has generated a staggering $93.4 million USD domestically and $9 million USD overseas for a worldwide tally of $102.4 million USD.

Produced in secret for roughly $7 million USD, the nearly three-hour-long film directed by comedian Nathan Fielder and filmmaker Lance Oppenheim takes place over three years. The narrative begins as Holmes prepares for her 11-year prison sentence for defrauding investors, transforming into a word-of-mouth smash following a surprise premiere at the Telluride Film Festival. The documentary initially opened to $15 million USD domestically in mid-October and has remained a dominant big-screen draw driven by strong reviews and a demographic that is overwhelmingly under 35 years old.

CASIO G-SHOCK and HIDDEN.NY have officially partnered to release the limited-edition 2110HDN-8A. Blending rugged durability with understated city style, the collaborative analog-digital timepiece reimagines a classic silhouette with custom branding and unique details that pay direct homage to New York City.

Built for everyday wear, the collaborative model features a robust stainless steel and resin case paired with a matching stainless steel band. Measuring 49.3 × 44.4 × 11.8 mm, the shock-resistant construction is protected by mineral glass and offers water resistance up to 200 meters. The sleek silver dial is elevated by HIDDEN®'s signature green accents positioned at the 3, 6, 9, and 12 o'clock markers, while a custom HIDDEN® logo is integrated into the 9 o'clock inset dial.

Further cementing the New York inspiration, the hardware features intricate Statue of Liberty engravings on both the case back and the clasp. To complete the commemorative release, the watch arrives in specially designed custom packaging modeled directly after the aesthetic of Canal Street souvenir shops.

items.title: Brioche armchairs, butter sculptures and edible chandeliers: meet the new food artists
items.summary:
Culinary artists are turning fashion shows and design fairs into a feast for the eyes

A pretty Venetian chandelier featuring delicate pink flowers and cascading blue leaves hangs from a ceiling. A hazy, warm light radiates from its tulip bulbs. Suddenly, a woman reaches up and snaps off one of the flower stems, giggling as she begins to nibble it. Welcome to the weird and wonderful world of Laila Gohar. The Egyptian-born, New York-based artist is part of a new wave of culinary artists blurring the lines between sustenance and spectacle, and this troupe have quickly become a firm fixture at fashion parties and design fairs, turning dining into a phenomenon and delight.

Gohar describes the chandelier, made entirely from hand-spun sugar (including the silver chain that suspended it) as her “favourite thing she has done in recent history”. It joins a long list of extravagant yet still edible installations she has created, including lifesize armchairs made of brioche, an entire room constructed with Belgian chocolate and a four-metre-long mortadella that had to be lifted into the party’s venue using a crane.

items.title: In a flap: how the butterfly became a symbol of gen Z resilience – and anxiety
items.summary:
The delicate insect has become fashion’s favourite motif again – but having represented sexuality in the 90s and the soul in Greco-Roman times, what does it say about youth culture today?

• Don’t get Fashion Statement delivered to your inbox? Sign up here

In the new Gucci campaign, Mariah Carey blows a goodbye kiss to 2026 in the most Mariahhhh way possible. Dressed in a fake fur coat and an azure dress, she enters a Christmas party to the twinkly sounds of All I Want For Christmas Is You. There are beautiful people, presents wrapped with Gucci string and butterflies, which have been associated with the popstar since her 1997 album, Butterfly, but have recently fluttered back to become a symbol of gen Z defiance and girlhood.

Carey serves as fairy godmother to the other “pop girlies” who have embraced the emblem, from PinkPantheress to Dua Lipa; Rachel Chinouriri to Marina and the Diamonds. At the Academy Museum gala in October, the singer Janelle Monáe looked as if she might take flight in a Robert Wun couture gown, with wide, yonic wings. Elsewhere, Tate McRae recently wore a black sequined butterfly bra and matching butterfly wing belt from lingerie wunderkind Ludovic de Saint Sernin. Both Swedish popstar Zara Larsson and her fans are championing glittery butterfly makeup motifs.
items.t: In a flap: how the butterfly became a symbol of gen Z resilience – and anxiety
